bf20: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00
bf30: 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00 00

; Decompress 2 world map rows at Y=$41 into RAM at $0600-$07ff
;  Note if a row is more than 256 bytes, it will just wrap and overwrite the
;  beginning.
bf40: a5 41        LDA $41
bf42: 0a           ASL         ; Get row pointer
bf43: aa           TAX
bf44: 90 0d        BCC +$0d  [$bf53]
bf46: bd 00 81     LDA $8100,X
bf49: 85 10        STA $10
bf4b: bd 01 81     LDA $8101,X
bf4e: 85 11        STA $11
bf50: 4c 5d bf     JMP $bf5d
bf53: bd 00 80     LDA $8000,X
bf56: 85 10        STA $10
bf58: bd 01 80     LDA $8001,X
bf5b: 85 11        STA $11
bf5d: a0 00        LDY #$00    ;; Decompress row
bf5f: a2 00        LDX #$00
bf61: b1 10        LDA ($10),Y ; get tile value
bf63: 10 1d        BPL +$1d  [$bf82] ; bit 7 clear -> just this tile
bf65: c9 ff        CMP #$ff
bf67: f0 26        BEQ +$26  [$bf8f] ; $ff -> end of row
bf69: 29 7f        AND #$7f
bf6b: 85 12        STA $12
bf6d: e6 10        INC $10     ; inc data ptr
bf6f: d0 02        BNE +$02  [$bf73]
bf71: e6 11        INC $11
bf73: b1 10        LDA ($10),Y ; get repeat count, and write that many copies
bf75: a8           TAY
bf76: 88           DEY
bf77: a5 12        LDA $12
bf79: 9d 00 06     STA $0600,X
bf7c: e8           INX
bf7d: 88           DEY
bf7e: d0 f9        BNE +$f9  [$bf79]
bf80: a0 00        LDY #$00    ; (useless?)
bf82: 9d 00 06     STA $0600,X ; write last/only copy
bf85: e8           INX
bf86: e6 10        INC $10     ; inc data pointer and loop
bf88: d0 d7        BNE +$d7  [$bf61]
bf8a: e6 11        INC $11
bf8c: 4c 61 bf     JMP $bf61
bf8f: a5 41        LDA $41     ; Repeat all the above for the next row
bf91: 18           CLC
bf92: 69 01        ADC #$01
bf94: 0a           ASL
bf95: aa           TAX
bf96: 90 0d        BCC +$0d  [$bfa5]
bf98: bd 00 81     LDA $8100,X
bf9b: 85 10        STA $10
bf9d: bd 01 81     LDA $8101,X
bfa0: 85 11        STA $11
bfa2: 4c af bf     JMP $bfaf
bfa5: bd 00 80     LDA $8000,X
bfa8: 85 10        STA $10
bfaa: bd 01 80     LDA $8001,X
bfad: 85 11        STA $11
bfaf: a0 00        LDY #$00
bfb1: a2 00        LDX #$00
bfb3: b1 10        LDA ($10),Y
bfb5: 10 1d        BPL +$1d  [$bfd4]
bfb7: c9 ff        CMP #$ff
bfb9: f0 26        BEQ +$26  [$bfe1]
bfbb: 29 7f        AND #$7f
bfbd: 85 12        STA $12
bfbf: e6 10        INC $10
bfc1: d0 02        BNE +$02  [$bfc5]
bfc3: e6 11        INC $11
bfc5: b1 10        LDA ($10),Y
bfc7: a8           TAY
bfc8: 88           DEY
bfc9: a5 12        LDA $12
bfcb: 9d 00 07     STA $0700,X
bfce: e8           INX
bfcf: 88           DEY
bfd0: d0 f9        BNE +$f9  [$bfcb]
bfd2: a0 00        LDY #$00
bfd4: 9d 00 07     STA $0700,X
bfd7: e8           INX
bfd8: e6 10        INC $10
bfda: d0 d7        BNE +$d7  [$bfb3]
bfdc: e6 11        INC $11
bfde: 4c b3 bf     JMP $bfb3
bfe1: 60           RTS
